finance.text: The US Federal Reserve kept its key rate unchanged and signalled patience as inflation cools.
Wall Street closed at a record high, with the S&P 500 up 0.8% on chip stocks.
Brent crude rose 2% after producers extended output cuts.

ai.text: Nvidia unveiled a data centre chip it says doubles training throughput.
The EU agreed rules requiring developers of general-purpose AI models to publish training data summaries.
A robotics start-up raised $400m for warehouse AI.
